name: Gemma 4 E2B (LiteRT-LM, speculative decoding)
description: Google AI Edge LiteRT-LM build of Gemma 4 E2B. Ships an embedded draft model for speculative decoding (enabled by default) and runs the multimodal stack natively — text, images, and audio with no mmproj sidecar. GPU path uses hand-tuned Adreno OpenCL kernels.

name: Gemma 4 E2B (multimodal: text+image+audio)
description: Google Gemma 4 E2B instruct, Q4_K_M. Multimodal: accepts text, images, and up to 30s of audio. Ships with a BF16 mmproj sidecar (~987MB, required for image/audio).

name: Home 3B v3 (Home Assistant)
description: Fine-tuned for Home Assistant smart home control. Can turn on lights, set thermostats, and answer questions about your home. Recommended for HA users.

name: Home 1B v3 (Home Assistant)
description: Smallest Home Assistant model. Runs on very low-RAM devices (Raspberry Pi, old phones). Less capable than 3B but still controls devices.

name: Qwen2.5 1.5B Instruct
description: Alibaba's compact instruct model. Best balance of quality and speed for 6-8GB phones.

name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B
description: DeepSeek R1 reasoning distilled into Qwen 1.5B. Strong chain-of-thought for its size.

name: Gemma 3 1B Instruct
description: Google's smallest Gemma 3 instruct model. Fast inference on older devices.

name: Gemma 2 2B Instruct
description: Google's Gemma 2 compact model with good reasoning for its size.

name: Gemma 3 4B Instruct
description: Google's mid-size Gemma 3. Better quality, needs 8GB+ RAM.

name: Llama 3.2 1B Instruct
description: Meta's smallest instruct model. Fastest option for low-RAM devices.

name: Llama 3.2 3B Instruct
description: Meta's 3B instruct. Good quality step up from 1B, needs 6GB+ RAM.

name: SmolLM2 1.7B Instruct
description: HuggingFace's efficient small model. Good for resource-constrained devices.

name: Phi-3.5 Mini Instruct
description: Microsoft's 3.8B mini model. Strong reasoning and coding, needs 8GB+ RAM.

name: Qwen2.5 3B Instruct
description: Alibaba's 3B instruct. Great multilingual support, needs 6GB+ RAM.

name: Realistic Vision V5.1
description: Photorealistic SD 1.5 fine-tune. High quality portraits and scenes. 512x512.

name: DreamShaper V8
description: Versatile SD 1.5 model. Great for illustration, fantasy, and photorealism. 512x512.

name: AbsoluteReality V1.8.1
description: Photorealistic focus. Best for portraits and real-world scenes. 512x512.

name: Anything V4
description: Anime and illustration style. High quality character art. 512x512.
